summary: Iteration 18 — Verified the two default tile vendors (SLV Ceramics + Ananta Ceramics, both phone +919945842205) are ALWAYS injected as the first two candidates for tile/ceramic/vitrified/kajaria material discovery, each with a unique uuid.hex id (default=true, status=FOUND, location=Bengaluru), while real web-discovered vendors are appended after. Backend pytest 14/14 pass in /app/backend/tests/test_default_tile_vendors.py: (a) POST /api/sourcing/discover with 'Kajaria vitrified floor tiles' → status DISCOVERED with both defaults present, both phones equal '+919945842205', unique ids, no _id leak, and no duplicate phones dropped by the +91 mobile dedup (the phones_seen set is seeded from defaults, so no external candidate can shadow them — verified 10 candidates total in the live run); (b) non-tile material ('steel rebar TMT bars') returns candidates with zero SLV/Ananta and no default flag; (c) POST /api/sourcing/campaigns/{id}/launch without a linked Telegram userbot returns HTTP 400 with detail 'Link your Telegram account first (Telegram AI tab)'; unknown campaign → 404; unauthenticated launch → 401/403; (d) GET /api/sourcing/campaigns and /campaigns/{id} return the campaign (no _id), get_campaign includes 'best' (null when no deals) and would attach deal_status/latest_quote/agreed_price/transcript when deals exist; (e) max_price < target_price → 400. Frontend Playwright on /sourcing (admin logged in): Discover form submits, campaign view renders 10 vendor cards, first two are 'SLV Ceramics' and 'Ananta Ceramics' each with '+919945842205' and 'Preferred tiles vendor…' note, all data-testid=src-vendor-<id> values are unique (10/10), Telegram-not-linked warning (src-link-warning) is shown, ZERO React duplicate-key warnings in console (only the unrelated react-router v7 future-flag warnings). Code review of launch(): dedup guard correctly seeds contacted_users from prior deals and adds uid to it after each successful start, so the second default (same telegram_user_id) is added to 'skipped' with reason 'same Telegram contact already being negotiated' and marked status=SKIPPED_DUPLICATE.

minor.issue: The dedup key is telegram_user_id, which is only known when the org has a linked Telegram account (resolve_phones_batch fills it). Without a linked account, both defaults keep telegram_user_id=None and both would fall into the 'not on Telegram' skip branch before ever reaching the dedup — so dedup is only exercised when Telegram is linked. That is the correct behavior (nothing is ever double-messaged), but consider a secondary dedup by normalized phone to also collapse duplicate-phone candidates in the launched[] response for tidy UI reporting.

/app/backend/tests/test_telegram_orders_and_defaults.py (iteration 15) still asserts the OLD single default 'SLV Ceramics (Muddinapalya)' with phone '+919980402205'. Those assertions will fail against the current code. Recommend deleting or updating that stale suite; it is superseded by /app/backend/tests/test_default_tile_vendors.py.

action_items: (Low) Delete or update /app/backend/tests/test_telegram_orders_and_defaults.py — its TestDefaultTileVendor assertions reference the old defaults and will now fail.
(Optional) Add a secondary phone-based dedup in launch() so the launched/skipped response is clean even before Telegram is linked.
critical_code_review_comments: auto_sourcing.py:60 _default_vendors() correctly mints a fresh uuid.hex per call so the two SLV/Ananta rows always have unique ids — this is what keeps React from complaining about duplicate keys on the two same-phone cards.

auto_sourcing.py:134 candidates from defaults are pushed first and phones_seen is seeded with '+919945842205'; this means any real web vendor that happens to publish the same number would be silently dropped. Acceptable given the user's explicit intent to always contact those two shops on that number.

auto_sourcing.py:202 launch() dedup uses telegram_user_id — correct guard because the same Telegram chat must never receive two openers. Consider also logging the SKIPPED_DUPLICATE candidate to audit for traceability (currently only the launched deals go through start_deal_internal which does its own logging).

AutoSourcing.js:264 keys candidates by (c.id || c.phone). With unique ids from the backend this is duplicate-key-safe; if the backend ever regressed to omitting id for defaults, both cards would collapse onto the same key. Consider strengthening to `c.id ?? \`${c.phone}-${i}\`` as a belt-and-braces guard.
auto_sourcing.py:120 502 'Web search returned no results' is only raised when BOTH hits and defaults are empty — so tile requests always avoid the 502 even when Tavily is rate-limited. Good.
seed_data_creation: Two sourcing_campaigns docs created for the admin org during discovery (tiles + steel). Harmless; can be cleared from mongo sourcing_campaigns collection if a clean state is required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Real Telegram userbot linking cannot be automated (needs api_id/api_hash + login OTP). Launch/negotiation live path is gated behind that. Backend pytest suite for defaults + gates lives at /app/backend/tests/test_default_tile_vendors.py. Old iteration_15 file test_telegram_orders_and_defaults.py has stale default assertions — main agent should delete or update it. Frontend /sourcing correctly renders two same-phone vendor cards with no React key errors.
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration was a data + robustness change (two seeded defaults, unique ids, dedup guard). Implementation in auto_sourcing.py and AutoSourcing.js is correct end-to-end for the requested behavior.
